SELECT id, task_uuid, user_id, resource_id, status, selected_bytes, verified_bytes, priority, speed_limit, revision, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM magnet_v2_download_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
